Peaceful
Apr 2026 • Solo
A beautiful old building brought back to life with a thoughtful renovation. The space has a peaceful, unhurried feel to it, a nice contrast to the bustle of the Old Quarter streets outside.
Coffee and food were both excellent. The wait staff were attentive without hovering, and I watched the barista take real care crafting each drink, no rushing. I went with a Vietnamese coffee and a croissant, and both delivered, rich, well-balanced coffee alongside a flaky, buttery pastry.
A great spot to slow down for a bit near the cathedral.

sealeg
Perth, Australia146 contributions

Worth the money. Excellent well presented staff and great coffee.
Mar 2026 • Couples
Needed a place to rest and saw this very clean and tidy coffee house just down from the St Joseph’s church in Hanoi and stepped inside to find comfortable seating, a good menu and equally well presented and hard working staff. This is not a slap dash coffee shop, it is superior to highlands, Starbucks and the like. It has baristas that take care in the making of their coffees and when they get one wrong they fix it with a smile and positive attitude. We enjoyed it here and came back a few times. Sadly we never ate here, it is a regret. We happened to have the same staff member on all occasions. The uniform is practical and professional. The drinks are not the cheapest here but the atmosphere and friendly welcome here is far beyond the Starbucks down the road which did not want our cash and offered even more overpriced coffee. Starbucks won’t accept cash. This company has no issue with cash and you get a smile as a bonus.
